health.input: body health.snapshot: {snapshot_b64}, standard padded base64, 1..65536 bytes once decoded
health.decoder: health.ts reads the supervisor's canonical JSON snapshot: v 1, private_cells (90) and corner_cells (20), each exactly verified, undetermined or failed; optional epoch, sequence and observed_at_ms as integers. Any other shape refuses; it never reduces evidence
health.bounds: 1..65536 bytes; 90 private cells and 20 corner cells
health.order: canon CHECKS (18 per organ, organ order) then CORNERS (two per organ pair, pair order) mapped to the pinned geometry

states.undetermined: dim hollow dashed disc, never drawn as healthy; the legend names it as verification unavailable

health.corners: drawn as diamonds; a corner is verified only when both of its organs confirmed
health.repairing: separate presentation set adds a shimmering ring; never changes the evidence cell or v1 snapshot keys; static ring under reduced motion
health.text_equivalent: a table of cell counts per organ and a list of every cell that is not verified
health.unavailable: cleared canvas with an explicit unavailable label

fingerprint.source: gate-aura head service returns {head} or {head, sources}; head is the Aura display head as 64 lowercase hex characters, the commitment over the ordered sources gate-ledger, kira-chain, code-chain
fingerprint.sources: when present, exactly three in that order; a source with a head has entries >= 1 and no absence, a source without a head has entries 0 and its own absence reason (gate-ledger-empty, kira-ledger-empty, code-record-missing)
fingerprint.derivation: the pentora_expand(root32) export of crates/pentora compiled to WASM takes the 32 raw head bytes and returns digest32 followed by 110 trits; digest = sha256(UTF8(pentora.display.v1) || 0x00 || head); there is no JavaScript derivation
fingerprint.module: app/core/pentora.wasm, fetched by the face from its own release, compiled with no imports, and checked against pinned vector 0 of crates/pentora/vectors before first use
fingerprint.digit_order: least significant base-3 digit first; increasing global cell index excluding 55
fingerprint.motion: follows crates/pentora motion.rs: a pending read draws and names nothing; a head that differs from the last sweeps in over 400 ms with changed digits ringed, and the digest, the head and the source head text stay hidden until 1200 ms; the first head, a repeated head and reduced motion settle at once; a failure forgets the last head
fingerprint.race_guard: only the latest read may draw or fail the canvas; a result for an older head is dropped

page_policy: script-src adds 'wasm-unsafe-eval' and connect-src is 'self' only so that the face can fetch and compile the pinned module; no other face has either
